lines.japanese: 「うん、そうだね。渡来さん、一緒にやろうか」
lines.english: “Yes, I suppose so. Watarai, shall we work together?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そう？　まあ、班長がそう言うならべつに」
lines.english: “Oh, yeah? Well, if that's what the team leader says, I guess I don't mind.”

lines.japanese: 「なんで不本意な態なの？」
lines.english: “Why are you pretending you don't want to?”

lines.japanese: 「どうせ俺たちと別れた途端ベタベタひっつくくせになァ」
lines.english: “You’re only going to start hanging all over each other the second we’re gone.”

lines.japanese: 「するかっ。しょーもな、ハイ行くよー」
lines.english: “As if. What a stupid thing to say. Come on, let's go.”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、待ってよ渡来さん」
lines.english: “Oh, wait, Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、おれたちＤ列の方行ってきますんで。ふたりとも仲良くやってくださいね」
lines.english: “We'll head over to Row D, then. You two play nice.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、善処する」
lines.english: “Yes. We'll make every effort.”

lines.japanese: 「ひとのことより自分の心配した方がいいんじゃねえの」
lines.english: “You might wanna worry about yourself instead of us.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「はねだー、はやくしろー」
lines.english: “Hanedaaa! Hurry up!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、はい、いま行きます」
lines.english: “Oh, yes. I'm coming.”

lines.japanese: 僕は配置図を片手に、棚の向こうへ消えた渡来さんの姿を追った。
lines.english: Floor plan in hand, I followed Watarai as she vanished beyond the shelves.

lines.japanese: 「えーっと、Ｄ列一般書籍……は向こうか……」
lines.english: “Let's see. Row D, general books... That's over there...”

lines.japanese: フロアは結構広い。客としてこの店に来たときは特別感じなかったけれど、自分たちの手で一段一段処理してゆくことを思えば気の遠くなる広さだ。
lines.english: The sales floor was fairly large. It hadn't seemed remarkable when I came here as a customer, but imagining us working through it one shelf at a time made it feel endless.

lines.japanese: しかも僕たちは未経験者。人数が揃って安心していたけれど、のんびりやっていたら二時間じゃ終わらないかもしれない。
lines.english: And we were complete beginners. Having enough people had reassured me, but if we took our time, we might not finish even in two hours.

lines.japanese: これはちょっと気合を入れて掛からなければ──
lines.english: We would have to throw ourselves into this—

lines.japanese: 「はーねだくん！」
lines.english: “Haaaaneda!”
“Whoa?!”

lines.japanese: 配置図を確かめながら歩いていたら、とつぜん棚の陰から渡来さんが飛びついてきた。
lines.english: As I walked with my eyes on the floor plan, Watarai suddenly sprang at me from behind a shelf.

lines.japanese: 「ふにゃ～、だいちゅき～」
lines.english: “Mnyaaah, I wuv youuu.”
“Wh-what...?”

lines.japanese: 悪いものでも食べたのだろうか。
lines.english: Had she eaten something bad?

lines.japanese: 「いや、どうせ陰でイチャついてると思われてるなら、本当にイチャついとかないと疑われ損かなーって」
lines.english: “Well, if they already think we’re back here getting all lovey-dovey, we might as well actually do it. Otherwise we’re getting blamed for nothing.”

lines.japanese: 彼女は僕の体にしがみついたまま、真顔でそんなことを言った。
lines.english: Still clinging to me, she said this with a perfectly straight face.

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだ。でも、のんびりやってる暇はなさそうだよ。早く取りかかっちゃおう」
lines.english: “I see. But it doesn't look like we have time to fool around. Let's get started.”

lines.japanese: くすぐったい気持ちもあって、つい真面目ぶってしまう。余裕がないのは本当だけど。
lines.english: I felt a little ticklish inside, so I found myself putting on a serious air. It was true that we had no time to spare, though.

lines.japanese: 「あれ、淡泊」
lines.english: “Wow. Cold.”

lines.japanese: 「嬉しいけど仕事中だからね。公私のけじめは付けなきゃ」
lines.english: “I'm happy, but we're at work. We have to keep our private and professional lives separate.”

lines.japanese: 「あれっ、しかも私、オトナ目線で説教されてる！　うわ、なんか急に、自分が所構わないアーパー女になった気分！」
lines.english: “Wow, now I’m getting the grown-up lecture! Suddenly I feel like some airhead who can’t keep her hands to herself, no matter where she is!”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんは僕を突きとばすように両手をあげた。
lines.english: Watarai raised both hands as though shoving me away.

lines.japanese: 「ちっ、やってくれたな羽田鷹志」
lines.english: “Tch. You'll pay for that, Takashi Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 「僕だって残念だよ。せっかく渡来さんが珍しく可愛い声出してくれたのに」
lines.english: “I'm disappointed too. You finally used a cute voice for once.”

lines.japanese: 「──そんなもん出してないでゴワス。おいどん、こんな声しか出ないでゴワス」
lines.english: “—did no such thing, by thunder. This here is the only voice I can make, by thunder.”
“Sigh...”

lines.japanese: 録音しておけばよかった。
lines.english: I wished I had recorded it.

lines.japanese: 片方が棚に本を挿しこむ。もう一方が図面でその配置の正誤を確認する。
lines.english: One person inserted books onto the shelves. The other checked the diagram to make sure each one was in the right place.

lines.japanese: ふたりで役割をときおり交替しながら、端まで続けてゆく按配だ。
lines.english: We would trade roles from time to time and continue that way to the end.

lines.japanese: いまは渡来さんが挿してゆく係。ジュニア向けの文庫本を黙々と埋めていっている。
lines.english: At the moment, Watarai was shelving. She silently filled a section with paperbacks for younger readers.

lines.japanese: 「あの、渡来さん……」
lines.english: “Um, Watarai...”

lines.japanese: 「なにー」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 手が止まらないのは仕事熱心だけれど、顔も向けてくれないのはちょっと寂しい。
lines.english: It was admirable that her hands never stopped, but I felt a little lonely when she wouldn't even turn her face toward me.

lines.japanese: 「なんか話しながらやろうよ」
lines.english: “Let's talk while we work.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、ごめん、公私のけじめは付けろって彼氏に言われたからー」
lines.english: “Oh, sorry. My boyfriend told me to keep my private and professional lives separate.”

lines.japanese: もしかして根に持ってるのだろうか。
lines.english: Was she holding a grudge?

lines.japanese: 「渡来さん」
lines.english: “Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 「んー？」
lines.english: “Hmm?”

lines.japanese: 「さっきのもう一回言って」
lines.english: “Say that thing from before again.”

lines.japanese: 「公私のけじめは付けろ」
lines.english: “Keep your private and professional lives separate.”

lines.japanese: 「や、それじゃなくて、あの……だ、だいちゅきってやつ」
lines.english: “No, not that. The, um... ‘I wuv you’ part.”

lines.japanese: 「だいちゅき」
lines.english: “I wuv you.”

lines.japanese: やっぱり根に持ってる。
lines.english: She was definitely holding a grudge.

lines.japanese: 「ちなみに、根に持ってるとかじゃなくて、仕事は真面目にしたいだけだから」
lines.english: “And just so you know, I'm not holding a grudge. I only want to take the job seriously.”

lines.japanese: しかも読まれてた。
lines.english: And she had read my mind.

lines.japanese: 「そ、そうだよね、はは」
lines.english: “R-right. Of course. Haha.”

lines.japanese: だけど彼女の言うとおりだ。私語はミスを招くもとになる。自制してしかるべきだ。
lines.english: But she was right. Idle chatter invited mistakes. Self-restraint was only proper.

lines.japanese: そして僕は、そんな、やるべきときはちゃんとやる渡来さんを一層好きになった。
lines.english: And seeing that Watarai could buckle down when the time came made me love her even more.

lines.japanese: 彼女に恥じない男になるべく、僕も真剣に仕事へ取りくもう。
lines.english: I would take my work seriously too, so that I could become a man worthy of her.

lines.japanese: 「あれ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 気を引きしめたせいか、さっそく誤配置を見つけてしまった。
lines.english: Perhaps tightening my focus had paid off. I immediately found a misplaced book.

lines.japanese: 少女向けのポップなタイトルが並ぶ中、場違いなケバケバしい背表紙が一点浮きあがっている。
lines.english: Amid the bright, poppy titles for young girls, one garish spine stood out glaringly.

lines.japanese: 『ぷるるんボディにウハウハＰＹＵ！　～緊縛巨乳姉妹はぶっといのがお好き～』
lines.english: “*Jiggly Bodies, Happy-Happy Sploosh! ~The Bound Big-Titty Sisters Like It Thick~*”

lines.japanese: これは……なんというか、ええと、ロックなタイトルだ。アダルト向けの官能小説だろうか。
lines.english: This was... how should I put it? A very rockin' title. Was it an erotic novel for adults?

lines.japanese: 僕でさえ怯んでしまうというのに、小鳩ぐらいの女の子が訪れるこの一角に、こんないかがわしい本があったら大変だ。
lines.english: Even I found it intimidating. If something this indecent sat in a section visited by girls Kobato's age, it would be a serious problem.

lines.japanese: 「渡来さん、ここ間違ったのが置いてある」
lines.english: “Watarai, there's a book in the wrong place here.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、ほんと？　なんて本？」
lines.english: “Oh, really? What's the title?”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんは手を休めず、どんどん先の棚へ進んでいた。
lines.english: Watarai kept working without pause, moving farther and farther down the shelves.

lines.japanese: 「ええと、ベルギー書院の、マタニティ文庫っていうシリーズなんだけど……」
lines.english: “Um, it's from Belgium Books. A series called Maternity Paperbacks...”

lines.japanese: 「うんー、書名はー？」
lines.english: “Okay. What's the title?”

lines.japanese: 「ぷ、ぷるるん何とかってやつ」
lines.english: “J-jiggly something.”

lines.japanese: 「はー？　分かんない、ちゃんと言ってよ」
lines.english: “Huh? That doesn't tell me anything. Say it properly.”

lines.japanese: 僕が言いよどんでいる間に、渡来さんはどんどん離れていく。
lines.english: While I faltered, Watarai kept moving farther away.

lines.japanese: 「えっと……ぷ、ぷるるん、ボディに……」
lines.english: “Um... J-jiggly bodies...”

lines.japanese: 「なにー、聞こえないよ。もっと大っきい声でー」
lines.english: “What? I can't hear you. Louder!”

lines.japanese: 「だから、ぷるるんボディに……う、うはうは、ぴゅ……」
lines.english: “I said, jiggly bodies... h-happy-happy... sploosh...”

lines.japanese: 「なに、ふざけてんの？　公私の別は付けろって言ったの誰」
lines.english: “Why are you goofing around? Who told me to keep my private and professional lives separate?”

lines.japanese: ふざけてないから言いたくないのに。
lines.english: I didn't want to say it precisely because I wasn't goofing around.
“Jig—”

lines.japanese: 僕は覚悟を決めて息を吸いこんだ。
lines.english: I steeled myself and drew a deep breath.

lines.japanese: 「ぷるるんボディにウハウハぴゅっ！　緊縛巨乳姉妹はぶっといのがお好き！」
lines.english: “Jiggly Bodies, Happy-Happy Sploosh! The Bound Big-Titty Sisters Like It Thick!”

lines.japanese: 「えー？　最後の方がぜんぜん聞こえなーい」
lines.english: “What? I couldn't hear the last part at all!”

lines.japanese: 「ぶっといのがお好きっ！」
lines.english: “They like it thick!”

lines.japanese: 「もーいっかーい」
lines.english: “One more tiiime.”

lines.japanese: 「ぶっといのが……あれ？」
lines.english: “They like it... Huh?”

lines.japanese: おかしい。そんな馬鹿な。さすがにこれだけの声量で届かないはずはない。
lines.english: Something was wrong. This was absurd. There was no way she hadn't heard me at that volume.

lines.japanese: 「ずいぶんロックなシャウトじゃねえか」
lines.english: “That's one hell of a rock scream.”

lines.japanese: 「うわあっ」
lines.english: “Waaah!”

lines.japanese: 気付いたら針生さんと山科さんが後ろに立っていた。
lines.english: Before I knew it, Hariu and Yamashina were standing behind me.

lines.japanese: 「フゥー、驚いたな委員長。清らかな聖人ぶったツラして、ぶっといのがお好きとは畏れいる」
lines.english: “Haaaah. I'm impressed, Class Rep. You walk around with the pure face of a saint, yet you like it thick. I'm awed.”

lines.japanese: 「ち、違うんです、聞いてください。それはおれじゃなくて、緊縛巨乳姉妹が──」
lines.english: “Th-that's not it! Please listen. It isn't me—the Bound Big-Titty Sisters are the ones who—”

lines.japanese: うろたえる僕の慌てざまを、気付けばみんながにやにや見守っていた。
lines.english: I looked around and found everyone watching my panic with a grin.

lines.japanese: 中でもとりわけこのひとは楽しそうだった。
lines.english: One person in particular looked delighted.

lines.japanese: 「んー？　なにが好きだって？　もっかい言ってみー？」
lines.english: “Hmm? What was it you liked? Say it one more time.”

lines.japanese: 「渡来さん……実は最初から全部知ってたんでしょ……」
lines.english: “Watarai... You knew exactly what it was from the very beginning, didn't you?”

lines.japanese: ひどい言わせプレイ。
lines.english: What a cruel make-him-say-it game.

lines.japanese: やっぱり根に持ってたんだと思う。
lines.english: She had been holding a grudge after all.

lines.japanese: こうして羽田班の一日バイトは終わった。
lines.english: And so the Haneda team's day at the bookstore came to an end.
